# 2 Baruch Chapter 83 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**83:1** "Therefore hear, O Israel, and be instructed, O children of Jacob, and be prepared to meet the holy coming days."

**83:2** "For the days will come when Jerusalem will be restored, and the exiles will return, and Zion will be inhabited again."

**83:3** "And the temple will be built again, and the sacrifices will be offered upon the altar."

**83:4** "And the priests will return to their service, and the Levites will return to their ministries."

**83:5** "And the law will remain with you; and the commandments will be fulfilled; and the covenant of the Holy One will endure forever."

**83:6** "But now, hear me: do not depart from the commandments of the Mighty One; and do not seek after the things of the Gentiles."

**83:7** "For the nations will perish; and the Gentiles will be destroyed; but Israel will endure forever."

**83:8** "And the seed of Jacob will live forever, and it will be the end of all that is passing away."

**83:9** "Now hear me, O my brethren; I am greatly troubled for you. For I know that there are among you those who have forsaken the covenant."

**83:10** "But they will be counted as Gentiles; and they will receive the reward of the nations."

**83:11** "For you are my brethren; and the name of Israel was given to you; and you were separated from the nations to be holy."

**83:12** "But you have walked in the ways of the Gentiles, and you have forsaken the law of the Mighty One."

**83:13** "Now I entreat you: return to your heart, and repent from your evil deeds, and turn to the Lord your God."

**83:14** "For he will have mercy on you, even as he had mercy on your fathers."

**83:15** "And he will not desert you, and he will not forsake you; but he will restore you, and he will be with you."

**83:16** "For it is written in the law: 'The Lord your God is a merciful God; he will not forsake you, and he will not destroy you, and he will not forget the covenant of your fathers.'"

**83:17** "And now, O my brethren, do not be troubled; for the tribulation will pass away, and the time of affliction will depart."

**83:18** "And the Mighty One will gather you again from among all the nations where he has scattered you."

**83:19** "And he will lead you back to Zion; and he will restore to you the holy temple; and he will give you back the vessels of the sanctuary."

**83:20** "And you will dwell again in the holy land; and you will be at peace; and the nations will not oppress you again."

**83:21** "And you will be called children of the Mighty One; and you will be called the children of the Holy One; and you will inherit the holy land forever."

**83:22** "And you will be blessed, and the whole earth will be blessed with you."

**83:23** "For the Mighty One will not forget his people, and will not be indifferent to his heritage."

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering arbitrated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Where translators diverged, SOPHIA selected the rendering best balancing accuracy, readability, and theological fidelity.*
